brief: The composition depicts the surface of dark slate, meticulously cross-sectioned to reveal the preserved structure of petrified wood. Intricate, fractal patterns emerge, tracing the original grain lines and the points of crystalline decay. These detailed fossilized networks are sharply delineated by stark white chalk lines, making the subsurface geology appear tactile and illuminated. The visualization is purely observational, presenting a profound study of natural, structural time that remains perpetually still.

statement: This sketch visualizes the surface of dark slate cross-sectioned to reveal fossilized wood structures. Using a grid-based system of deforming lines that respond to noise functions over time, it creates intricate fractal patterns reminiscent of petrified grain and crystalline decay. The stark white chalk lines delineate these structures against the dark background, emphasizing the tactile quality of geological time. The composition remains still, offering an observational study of natural structural formations frozen in time.
